up: Find all compound records (compound_key and compound_name) and the associated document identifier (doc_id) from ChEMBL that reference the exact document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5725513'. Return each matching record exactly once, with the document identifier to allow verification of source. No additional filtering (e.g., by activity, assay, or target) is required; only the document identifier is the constraint.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT cr.cidx AS compound_key, cr.compound_name, d.doc_id AS doc_id
FROM compound_records cr
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725513';
